description:
Unregister and delete Beadwork worker tools from the package. These are gone for parent and child, not merely hidden.

## Kill list (rip out)

- `beadwork_delegate`
- `beadwork_worker_done`
- `beadwork_land_worker`
- `beadwork_worker_check`

Keep `beadwork_sync` on the parent. Keep start/close/reopen/create/update/comment/label/defer/dependencies on the parent.

## Files

- `packages/pi-beadwork-extension/src/index.ts` (tool registrations)
- tests that mention these tools
- docs/tool descriptions if in the same package README snippets

Do not delete orchestrator.ts here; unused imports can remain until delete-runtime, or stub the removed execute paths. Prefer: remove registerTool blocks and their helpers if that does not require deleting orchestrator yet. If index imports launchTicketWorker only for delegate, remove that import and leave orchestrator.ts unreferenced until delete-runtime (might trip lint unused — then export a comment or wait: **this issue may need delete-runtime if lint forbids unused modules**. If so, depend on nothing but keep orchestrator imported from a deprecated test skip... Better: this issue only removes tools; if that leaves unused imports, use a lint ignore only if unavoidable, otherwise this issue is allowed to stop importing orchestrator while leaving the file on disk until delete-runtime.

## Success criteria

- Those four tools are not registered.
- beadwork_sync still registered.
- Children never had a special path; once minions allowlist lands they cannot see close anyway.

## Test plan

- Unit: tool names registered (existing index tests).
- Regression: descriptions do not mention tmux workers.

## Considerations

index.ts is a hotspot. Do not also implement /bw run or close-issue goal-exit here.
title: Delete beadwork_delegate, worker_done, land_worker, and worker_check
